verses.en: The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.
verses.zh: 所罗门的歌，是歌中的雅歌。

verses.en: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.
verses.zh: 愿他用口与我亲嘴；因你的爱情比酒更美。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.
verses.zh: 你的膏油馨香；你的名如同倒出来的香膏，所以众童女都爱你。

verses.en: Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. Friends We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! Beloved They are right to love you.
verses.zh: 愿你吸引我，我们就快跑跟随你。王带我进了内室，我们必因你欢喜快乐。我们要称赞你的爱情，胜似称赞美酒。他们爱你是理所当然的。

words.g: to draw, used in a great variety of applications + +me/my
to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊，我虽然黑，却是秀美，如同基达的帐棚，好像所罗门的幔子。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.
verses.zh: 不要因日头把我晒黑了就轻看我。我同母的弟兄向我发怒，他们使我看守葡萄园；我自己的葡萄园却没有看守。

words.g: to glow, i.e. literally  or figuratively

verses.en: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?
verses.zh: 我心所爱的啊，求你告诉我，你在何处牧羊？晌午在何处使羊歇卧？我何必在你同伴的羊群旁边好像蒙着脸的人呢？

words.g: which, that + to have affection for

verses.en: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.
verses.zh: 你这女子中极美丽的，你若不知道，只管跟随羊群的脚踪去，把你的山羊羔牧放在牧人帐棚的旁边。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.
verses.zh: 我的佳偶，我将你比法老车上套的骏马。

words.g: Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings

verses.en: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.
verses.zh: 你的两腮因发辫而秀美；你的颈项因珠串而华丽。

words.g: to be at home, i.e.  to be pleasant
in + a succession, i.e. a string or  order
in + pierced, i.e. a bead of pearl

verses.en: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.
verses.zh: 我们要为你编上金辫，镶上银钉。

words.g: a succession, i.e. a string or  order

verses.en: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
verses.zh: 王正坐席的时候，我的哪哒香膏发出香味。

verses.en: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.
verses.zh: 我以我的良人为一袋没药，常在我怀中。

words.g: the breast of a woman or animal + +me/my

verses.en: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.
verses.zh: 我以我的良人为一棵凤仙花，在隐・基底葡萄园中。

words.g: a bunch of grapes or other fruit
the + a cover, i.e.  a village

verses.en: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.
verses.zh: 我的佳偶，你甚美丽！你甚美丽！你的眼好像鸽子眼。

verses.en: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.
verses.zh: 我的良人哪，你甚美丽可爱！我们以青草为床榻，

verses.en: The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.
verses.zh: 以香柏树为房屋的栋梁，以松树为椽子。

verses.en: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.
verses.zh: 我是沙仑的玫瑰花（或译：水仙花），是谷中的百合花。

words.g: a lily , as aflower of architectural ornament

verses.en: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
verses.zh: 我的佳偶在女子中，好像百合花在荆棘内。

words.g: like + a lily , as aflower of architectural ornament

verses.en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.
verses.zh: 我的良人在男子中，如同苹果树在树林中。我欢欢喜喜坐在他的荫下，尝他果子的滋味，觉得甘甜。

words.g: like + an apple , i.e. the fruit or the tree
to + the palate or inside of the mouth + +me/my

verses.en: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.
verses.zh: 他带我入筵宴所，以爱为旗在我以上。

verses.en: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.
verses.zh: 求你们给我葡萄干增补我力，给我苹果畅快我心，因我思爱成病。

words.g: in + something closely pressed together, i.e. a cake of raisins or other comfits
in + an apple , i.e. the fruit or the tree

verses.en: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.
verses.zh: 他的左手在我头下；他的右手将我抱住。

verses.en: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊，我指着羚羊或田野的母鹿嘱咐你们：不要惊动、不要叫醒我所亲爱的，等他自己情愿（不要叫醒……情愿：或译不要激动爱情，等它自发）。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
in + a doe or female deer
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.
verses.zh: 听啊！是我良人的声音；看哪！他蹿山越岭而来。

verses.en: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.
verses.zh: 我的良人好像羚羊，或像小鹿。他站在我们墙壁后，从窗户往里观看，从窗棂往里窥探。

words.g: the + a stag or male deer
to peep, i.e. glance sharply at

verses.en: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.
verses.zh: 我良人对我说：我的佳偶，我的美人，起来，与我同去！

verses.en: For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.
verses.zh: 因为冬天已往，雨水止住过去了。

words.g: to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away

verses.en: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
verses.zh: 地上百花开放，百鸟鸣叫的时候（或译：修理葡萄树的时候）已经来到；斑鸠的声音在我们境内也听见了。

words.g: the + a ring-dove, often  as a term of endearment

verses.en: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”
verses.zh: 无花果树的果子渐渐成熟；葡萄树开花放香。我的佳偶，我的美人，起来，与我同去！

words.g: and + the + a vine , especially the grape

verses.en: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.
verses.zh: 我的鸽子啊，你在磐石穴中，在陡岩的隐密处。求你容我得见你的面貌，得听你的声音；因为你的声音柔和，你的面貌秀美。

words.g: the + a craggy rock, literally or figuratively

verses.en: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.
verses.zh: 要给我们擒拿狐狸，就是毁坏葡萄园的小狐狸，因为我们的葡萄正在开花。

words.g: to wind tightly , i.e. to bind

verses.en: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.
verses.zh: 良人属我，我也属他；他在百合花中牧放群羊。

words.g: in + a lily , as aflower of architectural ornament

verses.en: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.
verses.zh: 我的良人哪，求你等到天起凉风、日影飞去的时候，你要转回，好像羚羊，或像小鹿在比特山上。

words.g: which, that + to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air
and + to flit, i.e. vanish away
the + a stag or male deer

verses.en: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
verses.zh: 我夜间躺卧在床上，寻找我心所爱的；我寻找他，却寻不见。

words.g: which, that + to have affection for

verses.en: I will get up now, and go about the city; in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
verses.zh: 我说：我要起来，游行城中，在街市上，在宽阔处，寻找我心所爱的。我寻找他，却寻不见。

words.g: and + in + a width, i.e.  avenue or area
which, that + to have affection for

verses.en: The watchmen who go about the city found me; “Have you seen him whom my soul loves?”
verses.zh: 城中巡逻看守的人遇见我；我问他们：你们看见我心所爱的没有？

words.g: which, that + to have affection for

verses.en: I had scarcely passed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, into the room of her who conceived me.
verses.zh: 我刚离开他们就遇见我心所爱的。我拉住他，不容他走，领他入我母家，到怀我者的内室。

words.g: which, that + to have affection for
which, that + to come, go in + +him/his/it

verses.en: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up nor awaken love, until it so desires.
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊，我指着羚羊或田野的母鹿嘱咐你们：不要惊动、不要叫醒我所亲爱的，等他自己情愿（不要叫醒……情愿：或译不要激动爱情，等它自发）。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
in + a doe or female deer
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all spices of the merchant?
verses.zh: 那从旷野上来、形状如烟柱、以没药和乳香并商人各样香粉薰的是谁呢？

words.g: to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire

verses.en: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage! Sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel.
verses.zh: 看哪，是所罗门的轿；四围有六十个勇士，都是以色列中的勇士；

words.g: which, that + to + Shelomah, David's successor

verses.en: They all handle the sword, and are expert in war. Every man has his sword on his thigh, because of fear in the night.
verses.zh: 手都持刀，善于争战，腰间佩刀，防备夜间有惊慌。

verses.en: King Solomon made himself a carriage of the wood of Lebanon.
verses.zh: 所罗门王用黎巴嫩木为自己制造一乘华轿。

words.g: the + Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine

verses.en: He made its pillars of silver, its bottom of gold, its seat of purple, the middle of it being paved with love, from the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 轿柱是用银做的，轿底是用金做的；坐垫是紫色的，其中所铺的乃耶路撒冷众女子的爱情。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Go out, you daughters of Zion, and see King Solomon, with the crown with which his mother has crowned him, in the day of his weddings, in the day of the gladness of his heart.
verses.zh: 锡安的众女子啊，你们出去观看所罗门王！头戴冠冕，就是在他婚筵的日子、心中喜乐的时候，他母亲给他戴上的。

verses.en: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves behind your veil. Your hair is as a flock of goats, that descend from Mount Gilead.
verses.zh: 我的佳偶，你甚美丽！你甚美丽！你的眼在帕子内好像鸽子眼。你的头发如同山羊群卧在基列山旁。

words.g: the + a she-goat , but masculine in plural
Gilad, a region East of the Jordan

verses.en: Your teeth are like a newly shorn flock, which have come up from the washing, where every one of them has twins. None is bereaved among them.
verses.zh: 你的牙齿如新剪毛的一群母羊，洗净上来，个个都有双生，没有一只丧掉子的。

words.g: to be  twinned, i.e.  duplicate or  jointed

verses.en: Your lips are like scarlet thread. Your mouth is lovely. Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.
verses.zh: 你的唇好像一条朱红线；你的嘴也秀美。你的两太阳在帕子内，如同一块石榴。

words.g: the + a pomegranate, the tree  or the fruit
thinness, i.e. the side of the head + +you/your

verses.en: Your neck is like David’s tower built for an armory, on which a thousand shields hang, all the shields of the mighty men.
verses.zh: 你的颈项好像大卫建造收藏军器的高台，其上悬挂一千盾牌，都是勇士的藤牌。

verses.en: Your two breasts are like two fawns that are twins of a roe, which feed among the lilies.
verses.zh: 你的两乳好像百合花中吃草的一对小鹿，就是母鹿双生的。

words.g: the breast of a woman or animal + +you/your
in + a lily , as aflower of architectural ornament

verses.en: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, I will go to the mountain of myrrh, to the hill of frankincense.
verses.zh: 我要往没药山和乳香冈去，直等到天起凉风、日影飞去的时候回来。

words.g: which, that + to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air
and + to flit, i.e. vanish away

verses.en: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.
verses.zh: 我的佳偶，你全然美丽，毫无瑕疵！

verses.en: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
verses.zh: 我的新妇，求你与我一同离开黎巴嫩，与我一同离开黎巴嫩。从亚玛拿顶，从示尼珥与黑门顶，从有狮子的洞，从有豹子的山往下观看。

words.g: from + Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
from + Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
Shenir or Senir, a summit of Lebanon
and + Chermon, a mount of Palestine

verses.en: You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride. You have ravished my heart with one of your eyes, with one chain of your neck.
verses.zh: 我妹子，我新妇，你夺了我的心。你用眼一看，用你项上的一条金链，夺了我的心！

words.g: from + the back of the neck + +you/your

verses.en: How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much better is your love than wine, the fragrance of your perfumes than all kinds of spices!
verses.zh: 我妹子，我新妇，你的爱情何其美！你的爱情比酒更美！你膏油的香气胜过一切香品！

words.g: to be  good  in the widest sense

verses.en: Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb. Honey and milk are under your tongue. The smell of your garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
verses.zh: 我新妇，你的嘴唇滴蜜，好像蜂房滴蜜；你的舌下有蜜，有奶。你衣服的香气如黎巴嫩的香气。

words.g: Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine

verses.en: My sister, my bride, is a locked up garden; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain.
verses.zh: 我妹子，我新妇，乃是关锁的园，禁闭的井，封闭的泉源。

words.g: to fasten up, i.e. with abar or cord
to fasten up, i.e. with abar or cord

verses.en: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits, henna with spikenard plants,
verses.zh: 你园内所种的结了石榴，有佳美的果子，并凤仙花与哪哒树。

words.g: a missile of attack, i.e. spear + +you/your
a pomegranate, the tree  or the fruit

verses.en: spikenard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of incense tree; myrrh and aloes, with all the best spices,
verses.zh: 有哪哒和番红花，菖蒲和桂树，并各样乳香木、没药、沉香，与一切上等的果品。

verses.en: a fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, flowing streams from Lebanon.
verses.zh: 你是园中的泉，活水的井，从黎巴嫩流下来的溪水。

words.g: and + to drip, or shed by trickling
Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine

verses.en: Awake, north wind, and come, you south! Blow on my garden, that its spices may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and taste his precious fruits.
verses.zh: 北风啊，兴起！南风啊，吹来！吹在我的园内，使其中的香气发出来。愿我的良人进入自己园里，吃他佳美的果子。

words.g: to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air
to drip, or shed by trickling

verses.en: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Friends Eat, friends! Drink, yes, drink abundantly, beloved.
verses.zh: 我妹子，我新妇，我进了我的园中，采了我的没药和香料，吃了我的蜜房和蜂蜜，喝了我的酒和奶。我的朋友们，请吃！我所亲爱的，请喝，且多多地喝！

verses.en: I was asleep, but my heart was awake. It is the voice of my beloved who knocks: “Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled; for my head is filled with dew, and my hair with the dampness of the night.”
verses.zh: 我身睡卧，我心却醒。这是我良人的声音；他敲门说：我的妹子，我的佳偶，我的鸽子，我的完全人，求你给我开门；因我的头满了露水，我的头发被夜露滴湿。

words.g: dripping to pieces, i.e. a ruin

verses.en: I have taken off my robe. Indeed, must I put it on? I have washed my feet. Indeed, must I soil them?
verses.zh: 我回答说：我脱了衣裳，怎能再穿上呢？我洗了脚，怎能再玷污呢？

verses.en: My beloved thrust his hand in through the latch opening. My heart pounded for him.
verses.zh: 我的良人从门孔里伸进手来，我便因他动了心。

verses.en: I rose up to open for my beloved. My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with liquid myrrh, on the handles of the lock.
verses.zh: 我起来，要给我良人开门。我的两手滴下没药；我的指头有没药汁滴在门闩上。

words.g: and + something to sieze with, i.e. a finger + +me/my

verses.en: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved left, and had gone away. My heart went out when he spoke. I looked for him, but I didn’t find him. I called him, but he didn’t answer.
verses.zh: 我给我的良人开了门；我的良人却已转身走了。他说话的时候，我神不守舍；我寻找他，竟寻不见；我呼叫他，他却不回答。

verses.en: The watchmen who go about the city found me. They beat me. They bruised me. The keepers of the walls took my cloak away from me.
verses.zh: 城中巡逻看守的人遇见我，打了我，伤了我；看守城墙的人夺去我的披肩。

verses.en: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊，我嘱咐你们：若遇见我的良人，要告诉他，我因思爱成病。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
which, that + to be sick? grieve

verses.en: How is your beloved better than another beloved, you fairest among women? How is your beloved better than another beloved, that you do so adjure us?
verses.zh: 你这女子中极美丽的，你的良人比别人的良人有何强处？你的良人比别人的良人有何强处，你就这样嘱咐我们？

words.g: which, that + just so, referring to the previous or following context

verses.en: My beloved is white and ruddy. The best among ten thousand.
verses.zh: 我的良人白而且红，超乎万人之上。

words.g: to flaunt, i.e. raise a flag

verses.en: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is bushy, black as a raven.
verses.zh: 他的头像至精的金子；他的头发厚密累垂，黑如乌鸦。

verses.en: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks, washed with milk, mounted like jewels.
verses.zh: 他的眼如溪水旁的鸽子眼，用奶洗净，安得合式。

verses.en: His cheeks are like a bed of spices with towers of perfumes. His lips are like lilies, dropping liquid myrrh.
verses.zh: 他的两腮如香花畦，如香草台；他的嘴唇像百合花，且滴下没药汁。

words.g: like + something piled up  raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre
a lily , as aflower of architectural ornament

verses.en: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires.
verses.zh: 他的两手好像金管，镶嵌水苍玉；他的身体如同雕刻的象牙，周围镶嵌蓝宝石。

words.g: a valve of a folding door
in + a gem, perhaps the topaz

verses.en: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
verses.zh: 他的腿好像白玉石柱，安在精金座上；他的形状如黎巴嫩，且佳美如香柏树。

words.g: bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or  marble
like + Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine

verses.en: His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 他的口极其甘甜；他全然可爱。耶路撒冷的众女子啊，这是我的良人；这是我的朋友。

words.g: the palate or inside of the mouth + +him/his/it
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?
verses.zh: 你这女子中极美丽的，你的良人往何处去了？你的良人转向何处去了，我们好与你同去寻找他。

verses.en: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
verses.zh: 我的良人下入自己园中，到香花畦，在园内牧放群羊，采百合花。

words.g: to + something piled up  raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre
and + to + to pick up, i.e.  to gather
a lily , as aflower of architectural ornament

verses.en: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.
verses.zh: 我属我的良人，我的良人也属我；他在百合花中牧放群羊。

words.g: in + a lily , as aflower of architectural ornament

verses.en: You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.
verses.zh: 我的佳偶啊，你美丽如得撒，秀美如耶路撒冷，威武如展开旌旗的军队。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
like + Tirtsah, a place in Palestine
like + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
like + to flaunt, i.e. raise a flag

verses.en: Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats, that lie along the side of Gilead.
verses.zh: 求你掉转眼目不看我，因你的眼目使我惊乱。你的头发如同山羊群卧在基列山旁。

words.g: the + a she-goat , but masculine in plural
the + Gilad, a region East of the Jordan

verses.en: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them.
verses.zh: 你的牙齿如一群母羊洗净上来，个个都有双生，没有一只丧掉子的。

words.g: to be  twinned, i.e.  duplicate or  jointed

verses.en: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.
verses.zh: 你的两太阳在帕子内，如同一块石榴。

words.g: the + a pomegranate, the tree  or the fruit
thinness, i.e. the side of the head + +you/your

verses.en: There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number.
verses.zh: 有六十王后八十妃嫔，并有无数的童女。

verses.en: My dove, my perfect one, is unique. She is her mother’s only daughter. She is the favorite one of her who bore her. The daughters saw her, and called her blessed. The queens and the concubines saw her, and they praised her.
verses.zh: 我的鸽子，我的完全人，只有这一个是她母亲独生的，是生养她者所宝爱的。众女子见了就称她有福；王后妃嫔见了也赞美她。

verses.en: Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?
verses.zh: 那向外观看、如晨光发现、美丽如月亮、皎洁如日头、威武如展开旌旗军队的是谁呢？

words.g: the + to lean out , i.e.  peep or gaze
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as
like + to flaunt, i.e. raise a flag

verses.en: I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower.
verses.zh: 我下入核桃园，要看谷中青绿的植物，要看葡萄发芽没有，石榴开花没有。

words.g: the + a stream, especially a winter torrent
(question) + to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom
the + a vine , especially the grape
the + a pomegranate, the tree  or the fruit

verses.en: Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people’s chariots.
verses.zh: 不知不觉，我的心将我安置在我尊长的车中。

verses.en: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you. Lover Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite, as at the dance of Mahanaim?
verses.zh: 回来，回来，书拉密女；你回来，你回来，使我们得观看你。你们为何要观看书拉密女，像观看玛哈念跳舞的呢？

verses.en: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.
verses.zh: 王女啊，你的脚在鞋中何其美好！你的大腿圆润，好像美玉，是巧匠的手做成的。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: Your body is like a round goblet, no mixed wine is wanting. Your waist is like a heap of wheat, set about with lilies.
verses.zh: 你的肚脐如圆杯，不缺调和的酒；你的腰如一堆麦子，周围有百合花。

words.g: the umbilical cord, i.e.  a bodice + +you/your
wheat, whether the grain or the plant
in + a lily , as aflower of architectural ornament

verses.en: Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe.
verses.zh: 你的两乳好像一对小鹿，就是母鹿双生的。

words.g: the breast of a woman or animal + +you/your

verses.en: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus.
verses.zh: 你的颈项如象牙台；你的眼目像希实本、巴特・拉并门旁的水池；你的鼻子彷佛朝大马士革的黎巴嫩塔。

words.g: in + Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan
the + Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance

verses.en: Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.
verses.zh: 你的头在你身上好像迦密山；你头上的发是紫黑色；王的心因这下垂的发绺系住了。

words.g: like + Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine
and + something dangling, i.e. a loose thread or hair

verses.en: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!
verses.zh: 我所爱的，你何其美好！何其可悦，使人欢畅喜乐！

verses.en: This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.
verses.zh: 你的身量好像棕树；你的两乳如同其上的果子，累累下垂。

words.g: and + the breast of a woman or animal + +you/your
to + a bunch of grapes or other fruit

verses.en: I said, “I will climb up into the palm tree. I will take hold of its fruit.” Let your breasts be like clusters of the vine, the smell of your breath like apples.
verses.zh: 我说：我要上这棕树，抓住枝子。愿你的两乳好像葡萄累累下垂，你鼻子的气味香如苹果；

words.g: the breast of a woman or animal + +you/your
like + a bunch of grapes or other fruit
the + a vine , especially the grape
like + an apple , i.e. the fruit or the tree

verses.en: Your mouth is like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are asleep.
verses.zh: 你的口如上好的酒。女子说：为我的良人下咽舒畅，流入睡觉人的嘴中。

words.g: and + the palate or inside of the mouth + +you/your
to + evenness, i.e.  prosperity or concord

verses.en: I am my beloved’s. His desire is toward me.
verses.zh: 我属我的良人，他也恋慕我。

verses.en: Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field. Let’s lodge in the villages.
verses.zh: 我的良人，来吧！你我可以往田间去；你我可以在村庄住宿。

verses.en: Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love.
verses.zh: 我们早晨起来往葡萄园去，看看葡萄发芽开花没有，石榴放蕊没有；我在那里要将我的爱情给你。

words.g: to load up , i.e. to start early in the morning
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom
the + a vine , especially the grape
the + a pomegranate, the tree  or the fruit

verses.en: The mandrakes produce fragrance. At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits, new and old, which I have stored up for you, my beloved.
verses.zh: 风茄放香，在我们的门内有各样新陈佳美的果子；我的良人，这都是我为你存留的。

words.g: an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way + +us/our

verses.en: Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.
verses.zh: 巴不得你像我的兄弟，像吃我母亲奶的兄弟；我在外头遇见你就与你亲嘴，谁也不轻看我。

words.g: the breast of a woman or animal
in + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.zh: 我必引导你，领你进我母亲的家；我可以领受教训，也就使你喝石榴汁酿的香酒。

words.g: to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to + +you/your
a pomegranate, the tree  or the fruit + +me/my

verses.en: His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.
verses.zh: 他的左手必在我头下；他的右手必将我抱住。

verses.en: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊，我嘱咐你们：不要惊动、不要叫醒我所亲爱的，等他自己情愿（不要叫醒……情愿：或译不要激动爱情，等它自发）。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.
verses.zh: 那靠着良人从旷野上来的是谁呢？我在苹果树下叫醒你。你母亲在那里为你劬劳；生养你的在那里为你劬劳。

words.g: the + an apple , i.e. the fruit or the tree
to wind tightly , i.e. to bind + +you/your
to wind tightly , i.e. to bind

verses.en: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of the LORD.
verses.zh: 求你将我放在你心上如印记，带在你臂上如戳记。因为爱情如死之坚强，嫉恨如阴间之残忍；所发的电光是火焰的电光，是耶和华的烈焰。

verses.en: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.
verses.zh: 爱情，众水不能息灭，大水也不能淹没。若有人拿家中所有的财宝要换爱情，就全被藐视。

words.g: to + to expire or  to extinguish
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?
verses.zh: 我们有一小妹；她的两乳尚未长成，人来提亲的日子，我们当为她怎样办理？

words.g: and + the breast of a woman or animal
to + a sister , literally and figuratively) + +us/our

verses.en: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.zh: 她若是墙，我们要在其上建造银塔；她若是门，我们要用香柏木板围护她。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor

verses.en: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.
verses.zh: 我是墙；我两乳像其上的楼。那时，我在他眼中像得平安的人。

words.g: and + the breast of a woman or animal + +me/my

verses.en: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.
verses.zh: 所罗门在巴力・哈们有一葡萄园；他将这葡萄园交给看守的人，为其中的果子必交一千舍客勒银子。

words.g: in + Baal-Hamon, a place in Palestine

verses.en: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.
verses.zh: 我自己的葡萄园在我面前。所罗门哪，一千舍客勒归你，二百舍客勒归看守果子的人。

verses.en: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!
verses.zh: 你这住在园中的，同伴都要听你的声音，求你使我也得听见。

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!
verses.zh: 我的良人哪，求你快来！如羚羊或小鹿在香草山上。

words.g: the + a stag or male deer
